text:
sahil (PM): ok taking a stab at a minimal-ship proposal to keep the launch date but reduce scope. quick read, please react and flag hard blockers. :thinking:
sahil (PM): proposal is to defer three nonblocking features: tenant analytics dashboard, advanced SSO (SCIM + provisioning), and tenant-level routing for now. keep core API, embeddings cache, model pinning, and canary rollout.
maria (Product): TL;DR good. can we quantify customer risk for deferring analytics? any enterprise customers actively gating on that?
sahil (PM): only Acme and BetaCorp asked for analytics; both indicated they'd accept a V1 analytics pilot (CSV exports + manual reports) for initial launch.
taylor (Eng Lead): engineering concerns: tenant-level routing touches infra sharding, which cascades into Dedicated capacity config. if we defer routing we avoid a week of infra rework.
taylor (Eng Lead): also need to confirm if canary rollout dependencies assume routing. if yes, we need a fallback plan.
aj (Eng): we can wire a simple tag-based routing for canary without full tenant routing. that reduces scope and keeps canary path intact.
lucy (Design): for analytics deferral, we should ship a telemetry banner and a short onboarding doc so customers know how to get export access. I can do a 1-pager. :+1:
sahil (PM): thanks. timeline recalc below — aiming to keep launch week but squeeze two dev sprints.
sahil (PM): ```
- Week 0: freeze feature list (today)
- Week 1: 2-sprint dev push (core + canary plumbing + embeddings cache)
- Week 3: QA + rollout rehearsals
- Week 4: launch window
```
taylor (Eng Lead): that schedule is tight but feasible if we cut advanced SSO. SCIM was the big time sink.
maria (Product): what about security compliance signoff? advanced SSO impacts audit docs. without it, do we still meet SOC checklist?
aj (Eng): yes, basic SSO (SAML + OIDC) is in and passes our checklist. SCIM/provisioning is a V1 item.
lucy (Design): we should mark analytics as "holdback - design" so UX work doesn't drift. I'll create a tiny TODO in Figma.
sahil (PM): decision call: defer tenant analytics, defer SCIM, defer tenant routing. keep canary with tag-routing, core API, embeddings cache, model pinning, and rollout ops. all agree?
maria (Product): agree, + require a clear V1 acceptance criteria doc for deferred features.
taylor (Eng Lead): agree, and add a mitigation ticket: if canary fails, rollback plan to single-region hosted variant.
aj (Eng): created ticket RT-412 with rollback steps and the tag-routing patch reference.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: canary-rehearsal-job queued for 1781818240 by @taylor
sahil (PM): perfect. lucy/maria — can you own the V1 acceptance doc and the customer comms draft? aim for EOD Friday.
lucy (Design): yep I got it.
maria (Product): will draft comms and hand to success for outreach.
sahil (PM): thanks team. i'll update the roadmap slice and post a follow-up with the trimmed release note. :rocket:
